reviewItem.question: For "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook: Use `0.16.1` as opposed to `0.16.0` on your installation…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The 0.16.0 chart removes spec.conversion (strategy Webhook pointing at the external-secrets-webhook /convert service) from the external-secrets CRDs, so promoting an existing installation to 0.16.0 can have the CRD update rejected with 'spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook'; the release notes say to use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0.
